pages.title: Island Breaker
pages.text:
■ Island Breaker is a mini game where you destroy debris washing ashore.
■ Launch and bounce the ball around to destroy debris and Raptures.
■ Find just the right angle to clear as much debris as possible!

pages.title: Scoring Points
pages.text:
■ Attack blocks to reduce their HP and earn points.
■ Get the ball to bounce as much as possible to earn tons of points!
■ Launching more balls makes it easier to score more points.

pages.title: Waves
pages.text:
■ Each wave causes blocks to drop down one row.
■ The game ends when blocks reach the bottom row.
■ Blocks gain more HP as you progress through waves.

pages.title: Skipping Waves
pages.text:
■ Use the Skip Wave button to skip a wave without playing.
■ Skipping waves still causes blocks to drop down and their HP to increase.
■ You cannot skip a wave if blocks are about to reach the bottom row.

pages.title: Blocks
pages.text:
■ Normal, elite, and bonus blocks will appear.
■ Blocks are destroyed when their HP reaches 0.
■ Elite blocks have more HP than normal blocks.
■ Bonus blocks grant more seashells when destroyed.

pages.title: Launching the Ball
pages.text:
■ Drag on the screen to aim the ball.
■ Release to launch the ball in the direction you're aiming.
■ While dragging, you can drag outside the launch area to cancel the launch.
■ Launched balls are automatically retrieved and can be used again in the next wave.

pages.title: Bouncing the Ball
pages.text:
■ The ball will bounce off blocks and walls when it hits them.
■ Launch the ball at the right angle to bounce it more and build higher combos.
■ Finding the best launch angle and maximizing bounces is the key to success.

pages.title: Retrieve Now
pages.text:
■ Use the Retrieve Now button to immediately retrieve launched balls.
■ Pressing the button while launching a ball will cancel any remaining ball launches.
■ The next wave will begin once all balls have been retrieved.

pages.title: Purchasing Balls
pages.text:
■ Balls can be purchased either individually or in groups of six.
■ You can use the Buy 6 option to receive a discount.
■ Purchasing balls requires seashells.
■ Balls cannot be purchased while any ball is currently bouncing around.

pages.title: Ball Rarity
pages.text:
■ Balls are divided into R, SR, and SSR rarities.
■ Higher-rarity balls offer better performance, but are harder to obtain.
■ SR and SSR balls have special effects.
■ Select a ball's icon to view its details.

pages.title: Obtaining Seashells
pages.text:
■ Destroy debris to obtain seashells as a reward.
■ Seashells can be used to buy additional balls.
■ Any unused seashells will be reset once the stage ends.

pages.title: Unique Skills
pages.text:
■ Each Nikke has a unique skill.
■ This skill is charged whenever a ball hits a block.
■ Once the skill is charged to 100%, it will be used automatically at the start of the next wave.
■ If it gets charged to 200%, it will be used twice in a row.
■ To view details about a skill, select its icon.

pages.title: Upgrading Unique Skills
pages.text:
■ A Nikke's unique skill will be upgraded as you reach certain waves.
■ Its attack power will increase as its level increases.
■ The amount of charge required to use it will also increase.

pages.title: Conch Shells
pages.text:
■ You can earn conch shells by finishing a run of the game.
■ The amount you earn depends on the wave you reach, with 50 being the max amount you can earn at once.
■ There is a limit to the number of conch shells you can earn in a week.
■ If you earn the max amount for three weeks, you'll be able to upgrade all traits.

pages.title: Traits
pages.text:
■ Traits can be upgraded using conch shells.
■ Upgrading them grants different effects.
■ Some traits can only be upgraded after a certain date.

pages.title: Resetting Traits
pages.text:
■ Traits can be reset.
■ Resetting traits will not reset your conch shells.
■ If you're trying to improve your score, make sure to upgrade your traits.

view.summary: A block breaker: launch your balls to break the debris rows that drop one row per wave, buy more balls with the Seashells you break loose, and survive as many waves as you can.

overview.title: A run
items: Score as many points as possible: damaging blocks scores points, and long bounce chains build combos.
Each wave a new row of blocks drops in and every block moves down one row. The run ends when a block reaches the bottom row.
Drag to aim, release to fire all your balls. They come back on their own (or with Retrieve Now) and the next wave starts. You start with 1 ball and 60 Seashells.
By the manager settings, while balls are in play the game speeds up by ×0.5 every 4 s, up to ×5 (normal speed ×1).
You can skip a wave without launching; blocks still drop and get tougher. Not allowed when blocks are one row from the bottom.
The wave table runs to wave 1,001; past that wave 1,001 repeats (block HP 14,839).

overview.title: Currencies
items: Used to purchase balls. 10 per block destroyed, 20 per bonus block. Unspent ones are lost when the run ends.
Used to acquire traits. Earned at the end of each run, more for reaching later waves (up to 50 a run). Total earning cap: 250, 500 from day 7, 800 from day 14. All traits together cost 800.
